questions.stem: Why is it not always economically worthwhile for farmers to increase all conditions to their optimum level?

options.text: Because plants cannot photosynthesize at optimum conditions
Because optimum conditions kill the plants
Because the cost of heating, lighting, and CO2 may exceed the extra income from crops

questions.explanation: Farmers must balance the cost of providing additional heating, lighting, and CO2 enrichment against the extra income generated from increased crop yields to ensure it remains profitable.
